* note that reductions are positive, increases negative numbers
* the high impact for N2O from liquid storage is currently incompatible with our default assumptions. We know that according to IPCC storage without a crust cover
* entails zero N2O emissions, while the emission factor for storage with crust cover is 0.5%. The default technology in the literature review is probably a
* liquid system without a crust cover, which explains the high impact of floating covers (CS_low) which are supposed to be similar to a natural crust. However, since in CAPRI so far
* we assume per default that liquid systems have a crust cover, the impact should be close to zero instead of +3000%. ON the other hand, the impact of CS_high is probably much higher
* than the -40%, because the literature review start
